segments.start_exact:
The scout stood where three roads cut three green tunnels in the pine
woods, and met at his feet.
segments.end_suffix: In his motor car, he had travelled the road
segments.summary: Scout Lathrop must decide which road to scout; torn between duty and love he leaves it to chance, questions a baker's boy, and heads to Carver Centre.

cohesion.place: Junction of three roads in the pine woods

gacd.goal: Decide which road to scout / discover the enemy's position
gacd.action: Spins his bicycle wheel to let chance decide; questions the baker's boy for information
gacd.conflict: Cannot cover three roads; internal conflict between duty and desire to see Beatrice; uncertainty

segments.reason: Unified by time/place at the road junction; focal character pursues a goal (choosing a route) against internal conflict and uncertainty, resolved when he decides to head to Carver Centre.

segments.start_exact:
In his motor car, he had travelled the road
many times
segments.end_exact: "I am WAITING for the enemy," explained Lathrop. "It's the same thing."
segments.summary: Lathrop reaches Beatrice Farrar's cottage and, despite his promise, courts her while claiming to be on duty; she rebuffs him and wishes the Reds would capture him.

cohesion.place: The road in front of the Farrar cottage

gacd.goal: Lathrop wants to woo Beatrice / stay near her under pretext of duty
gacd.action: He stops, flirts, refuses to leave, insists on guarding her
gacd.conflict: Beatrice repulses him and demands he go; verbal sparring

segments.reason: New place (Farrar cottage) and sustained flirtation-conflict between Lathrop and Beatrice; focal goal of wooing meets clear resistance. Kept as one scene despite dialogue ping-pong per rules.

segments.end_exact:
they watched him disappear rapidly around the turn in
the road.
segments.summary: Two Reds ambush and capture Lathrop; unable to keep a prisoner, they arrange his mock 'escape'/execution, and he rides off shot 'dead.'

cohesion.place: Road in front of the Farrar cottage

gacd.goal: The disguised Reds want to be rid of their prisoner Lathrop; Lathrop seeks to avoid court-martial
gacd.action: Capture, negotiation, staged escape and shooting
gacd.conflict: Standoff over what to do with the prisoner; Beatrice's objections

segments.reason: Same place but a distinct dramatic event (capture and mock execution) with clear goal/action/conflict and a resolved outcome (Lathrop rides off).

segments.end_exact: Behind her the car passed noisily on its way.
segments.summary: The sergeant insists on guarding the house and chats with Beatrice; the little soldier reports Lathrop vanished; Beatrice, bored and annoyed, retreats indoors when a Blue car passes.

cohesion.place: At the gate/front of the Farrar cottage

segments.reason: Same place, mostly conversational transition building suspense; no strong single GACD or ERAC structure, so narrative_scene fits until the place changes indoors.

segments.start_exact: She mounted the stairs, and crossing a landing moved down a long hall,
segments.end_exact: "You can BET I won't leave you!"
segments.start_prefix: Behind her the car passed noisily on its way.
segments.summary: Beatrice finds the crook ransacking her bedroom; the thieves threaten her for jewels; Lathrop returns, defeats them, the provost guard arrives, and Beatrice falls into his arms.

cohesion.place: Inside the Farrar house, Beatrice's bedroom

gacd.goal: Beatrice to escape the thieves; Lathrop to rescue her and capture the crooks
gacd.action: Confrontation, threats, Lathrop's rush and fight, capture by guard
gacd.conflict: Armed robbers threaten to choke Beatrice; physical fight

segments.reason: Clear place change indoors and a climactic dramatic scene with strong conflict (robbery/threat/fight) and resolved outcome (rescue, capture, embrace).
